behavioral_intents: Detect scheduled tasks that spawn script interpreters or LOLBins with command patterns indicative of code execution, encoding/obfuscation, registry manipulation, or remote content retrieval.
Detect system binaries being executed from non-standard filesystem locations, a common indicator of binary masquerading or DLL-hijacking attacks
Detect exfiltration of sensitive data via paste/text sharing services using command-line tools or scripting engines rather than browsers.

Detect shell interpreters (cmd.exe, powershell.exe) spawned from interactive applications (browsers, email clients, file explorer) making network connections to code hosting and paste-bin services, indicating potential command-and-control or payload download activity.
Detect system binary masquerading from non-standard locations and script interpreters spawned by scheduled task system processes with suspicious command patterns.
Detect exfiltration of sensitive data via text storage/pastebin services by non-browser processes (e.g., PowerShell, curl, wget uploading to code dump sites).
